title: Cyclic orbit classification for covers split by one root extension
statement: Let R be a commutative regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], g∈R a nonzerodivisor, and R/(g) regular. Let n>0 be an integer invertible in R. Let p:Y→Spec R be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] factoring through D(g). Put A=R[T]/(T^n-g), N=Spec A, q:N→Spec R the structure map, and V=D(g)⊂N. Suppose d≥0 and δ:Y×_{Spec R}V≅⨿_{Fin d}V [def-pc-fibre-product] is an isomorphism over V (δ followed by the fold equals the second projection). For every y∈Spec R there are S, an etale ψ:Spec S→Spec R, and z∈Spec S with ψ(z)=y. There are m≥0, h∈S, and positive integers e_k invertible in S, indexed by Fin m. The rings S and S/(h) are regular and h is a nonzerodivisor. Put B=∏_k S[T]/(T^{e_k}-h), M=Spec B, r:M→Spec S its structure map, and Z=D(h)⊂M. There is γ:Y×_{Spec R}Spec S≅Z over Spec S: γ;ι_Z;r equals the second projection. All rings and schemes are in universe u. There is no group action or tameness hypothesis: the supplied root splitting is the hypothesis of the classification.

proof.text: Obtain a pointed affine etale neighborhood, root degrees, and the compatible product root model from root_split_cover_cyclic_chart_model. Its equation is φ(g).
Apply etale_regular_divisor_base_change to φ and g. Combine its three regularity conclusions with the model isomorphism and the pointed etale data to produce the original existential conclusion.

theorem root_split_cover_cyclic_charts
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hg : IsSMulRegular R g)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {g})]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R)
    (hj : ∃ j : Y ⟶ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g),
      j ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) = p)
    (d : ℕ) (y : Spec R) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap R A g)
    ∀ (δ : pullback p (V.ι ≫ q) ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ V.toScheme),
      δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 V.toScheme) =
        pullback.snd p (V.ι ≫ q) →
    ∃ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (ψ : Spec S ⟶ Spec R) (z : Spec S),
      Etale ψ ∧ ψ z = y ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : S) (e : Fin m → ℕ),
        (∀ k, 0 < e k ∧ IsUnit (e k : S)) ∧
        IsRegularRing S ∧ IsSMulRegular S h ∧
        IsRegularRing (S ⧸ Ideal.span {h}) ∧
        let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
          AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C h)))
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap S (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C h))))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
          (algebraMap S (∀ k : Fin m,
            AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ e k - Polynomial.C h)) h)
        ∃ γ : pullback p ψ ≅ V.toScheme,
          γ.hom ≫ V.ι ≫ q = pullback.snd p ψ
